title: Theme system: semantic token layer with dark and light parity
description: All colour usage routes through a semantic token layer (surface, on-surface, primary, on-primary, accent, danger, warning, success, muted) with a complete palette declared for both light and dark themes. Every token declared for light is declared for dark. The application honours prefers-color-scheme on first visit and offers an explicit toggle whose choice persists for the session and for the signed-in user. Every token pairing used for text or essential UI passes the contrast thresholds in application-spa-REQ-019.
rationale: Theme parity declared as a token-layer invariant is checkable; theme parity declared as intent is not. The shipped token set in assets/tokens realises this requirement.
